hypothesis: The canonical 12-1 cross-sectional momentum signal preserves medium-term continuation while excluding the latest month's short-term reversal.

rule.score: close 21 sessions ago divided by close 252 sessions ago minus one
rule.selection: top one asset if its score is strictly positive, otherwise cash
rule.execution: next common session open to next month's rebalance open

multiple_testing_disclosure: Tested after plain 3/6/12-month long-cash and unskipped cross-sectional momentum failed; this is a distinct canonical published mechanism.
